|game_text=Deploy on table. Once per game, if Vader on table, may ▼ Obi-Wan. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ a [Grabber]. If you just attempted to ▼ or ▲ a card, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card; reshuffle.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3, the current text (version 4 of 4): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List of 2013, which prints the original release-sheet words again. The image here is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1271-41-front-master.png]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Oh, He's Not Dead, Not Yet]]): Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet, official text as of 18 June 2010<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010), page 8, slip 41 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Once per game, if Vader on table, may ▼ Obi-Wan. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ a [Grabber]. If you just attempted to ▼ or ▲ a card, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card; reshuffle.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-05-Oh_Hes_Not_Dead_Not_Yet.png]]) prints it. The slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Oh, He's Not Dead, Not Yet (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 7 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1271_41">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock7Type (Virtual Block 7 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on table. Once per game, if Vader on table, may ▼ Obi-Wan. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ a [Grabber]. If you just attempted to ▲ or ▼ a card, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' One change: the two arrows swap places (“▲ or ▼ a card”; the list writes “take into hand or deploy a card from Reserve Deck”). The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Oh, He's Not Dead, Not Yet (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-ohhesnotdeadnotyet-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual7-Light">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual7-Light/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034736/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “Deploy on table. Once per game, if Vader on table, may ▼ Obi-Wan. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ a [Grabber]. If you just attempted to ▼ or ▲ a card, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). Besides the words, the image differs from the release-sheet slip in one visible way: it prints slip number 41, which the release-sheet slip does not print.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 27)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=27 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1271-41-front-master.png]]: “Deploy on table. Once per game, if Vader on table, may ▼ Obi-Wan. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ a [Grabber]. If you just attempted to ▼ or ▲ a card, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
